citations.quote: This was a placebo-controlled study that enrolled 104 subjects (53 to clevipidine and 51 to placebo) who either had a history of hypertension or were hypertensive pre-operatively (mean baseline SBP was 179 mm Hg) for one of several cardiovascular operations (CABG and/or valve replacements) and whose blood pressure was to be lowered by at least 15%.

endpoint.text: Treatment failure rate during the treatment period (bailout for lack of efficacy, safety, or failure to achieve at least 15% decrease in SBP)

citations.quote: The primary metric was the failure rate of the two treatment groups during the time of interest (30-60 minutes during the infusion or until the start of anesthesia.) Treatment failure consisted of one of three components; 1) bailout for lack of efficacy (failure to have more than a nominal effect on blood pressure), 2) bailout for safety (emergence of an adverse event) or 3) bailout for treatment failure (failure to achieve at least 15% decrease in SBP).
